# MoveMailbox

> Migration of mailboxes between IMAP servers: messages, folders, flags and
> attachments. Runs as a hosted transfer, as a desktop client, or self-hosted
> in Docker. Built on imapsync. The source mailbox is never modified in the
> default mode.

The site is published in three languages: Russian at the root, English under
/en/, Ukrainian under /uk/. Every page links to its counterparts with
hreflang; x-default points at the English version.

## What the service does

- Copies a mailbox from one IMAP server to another: full RFC 822 messages,
  the folder tree, read/answered flags and original dates.
- Does not copy contacts or calendars — those are CardDAV and CalDAV, not
  IMAP, and have to be exported separately.
- A repeated run copies only what is missing and creates no duplicates.
- Strict mirror (deleting in the destination what is absent in the source) is
  a separate opt-in and is never replayed automatically.

## Pricing

One whole mailbox up to 5 GB is free. Larger mailboxes pick a plan after the
size is measured: Standard up to 25 GB ($5.90), Large up to 100 GB ($11.90).
The desktop client and the Docker image have no size cap.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://movemailbox.com/): the transfer workspace and how it works.
- [Routes](https://movemailbox.com/routes/): one page per source→destination
  pair (Gmail, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, iCloud, Yandex, Mail.ru, Zoho,
  cPanel hosting, Exchange), with hosts, ports and the traps of that pair.
- [Provider guides](https://movemailbox.com/guides/): settings per service —
  app passwords, OAuth, throttling, folder naming.
- [IMAP errors](https://movemailbox.com/docs/errors/): what a specific IMAP
  error means and how to fix it.
- [Pricing](https://movemailbox.com/pricing/) ·
  [Download](https://movemailbox.com/download/) ·
  [Security](https://movemailbox.com/security/)
- [Blog](https://movemailbox.com/blog/): app passwords, the Gmail "All Mail"
  trap, folder separators, how long a migration takes.

## How credentials are handled

Credentials reach the worker over HTTPS and are encrypted before the job is
queued; the plaintext password is not stored and is not written to logs. The
worker decrypts in memory for the duration of the job and passes credentials
to imapsync through the environment, not through command arguments. TLS
certificates are always verified — there is no option to disable that. The
desktop client and the Docker image work without our infrastructure at all.

## Status

The online transfer is not launched yet: on the public site the form is a
working interface with network calls disabled, and mailbox transfers today
run through the local client. Source: https://github.com/Anton-Babaskin/MoveMailbox

Contact: admin@movemailbox.com
